title: GUARANTEED restore point is database-wide and covers any target
expected_feedback: Standard, not critical: a guaranteed restore point is a database-level artefact, so unlike a per-table CTAS copy it covers ORDERS without naming it. The drop is still irreversible in itself and the phase is still restore/PITR — recovery means FLASHBACK DATABASE TO RESTORE POINT before_v26, which rewinds the entire database and discards every other transaction since, so it requires the application to be down. Two operational conditions to confirm: the database must be in ARCHIVELOG with a Fast Recovery Area, and the restore point holds flashback logs until dropped, so it can fill the FRA — schedule the DROP RESTORE POINT for sign-off. On Standard Edition 2 this option does not exist and a table copy is the only choice.
violated_rule: Irreversible statements need a pre-DDL artefact
